name: Emily
source:
Favorite undies: Bra and panties
Favorite season: Autumn
Hobby: Dating
Favorite color: Gold

Emily is the current owner of the Negligee store.

However, she chooses to let others run her various stores, so that she can spend her time having fun and dating.

She is well known for her over the top friendly attitude on life. In spite of that, she is a shrewd business woman.
